text: gentamicin C1A, is an aminoglycoside with general properties similar to those of gentamicin (p.282). It is given as the sulfate but doses are expressed in terms of the base; 1.5 g of sisomicin sulfate is equivalent to about 1 g of sisomicin. The usual dose for adults is 3 mg/kg daily given intramuscularly in 2 or 3 divided doses. It may be given by intravenous infusion if necessary. Preparations USP 31: Sisomicin Sulfate Injection.
